caption_L1: Number of non-EU citizens working in Italy in 2019 , by sector is a bar chart. The x-axis plots sector on categorical scale from Agriculture, hunting, fisheries to Transport and storage while the y-axis plots Number of individuals on linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 400,000.
caption_L2L3: By far the most non-EU citizens working in Italy seems to be employed in 'other services'. Industries and factories follows with over 300,000 non-EU citizens working in Italy. The smallest number of individuals seems to be employed in finance and insurance; information and communication; and PA, defense, mandatory social insurance.
